scope: All 177 live v019 vzaim- mutuality/reciprocity forms.
choice: Normalize nine observed case-sensitive forms from malformed vzaim- to the official standard vzajem- paradigm while preserving capitalization, case, number, and syntax.
motivation: The official dictionary contains only type-1 vzajėmno, vzajėmnosť, and vzajėmny, with standard examples using vzajem-. The inherited vzaim- layer is an East-shaped transliteration residue, not a distinct semantic option.
alternatives_rejected: Retain vzaim- as a national spelling variant; it is absent from the official headword family.
Replace with reciprocal internationalisms; that is unnecessary and less transparent across ordinary prose contexts.

validation.structure: TeX controls, references/citations, braces, math delimiters, and line counts unchanged
